verdict.rationale: Elicit has a dedicated help article for an official hosted MCP endpoint (https://elicit.com/api/mcp) with a ready-made `claude mcp add --transport http` command. The article also states that all API functionality is available through the MCP server to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP-compatible clients. missing for 10: a documented list of individual MCP tools and authentication/setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
